title: Paper Tube Packaging Supplier Checklist
question: What should buyers check when choosing a paper tube packaging supplier for candles, cosmetics or tea products?

company.legalName: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.

buyerFit: For buyers comparing paper tube packaging for candles, cosmetics, tea, fragrance, small gifts and specialty retail products.
checks: Confirm product diameter, product height, packed weight and whether the tube needs an inner tray or divider.
Compare closure style, cap structure, paperboard thickness, lining requirement and surface finish.
Check whether the tube is for retail display, gift presentation, shipping protection or a refill set.
Prepare artwork direction and finish requirements before asking for sample cost or production review.
Do not treat paper tube packaging as automatically suitable for every liquid, food or regulated product without project review.
